name: Denai Heya kara Otouto ga!
source:
''I want my brother to remember the warmth of real people when he goes to the game world... And I want him to respect his older sister (me) and apologize for his daily disrespect...''

A game where you play a game with your brother who is a shut-in!

[translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/6518]Freem![/url]]
